ai.title: Remove redundant text from /live page
ai.summary: Removed explanatory subtitles and raw country codes from the /live stats view. Simplified the hero text and list items to focus on metrics. Updates `freebuff/web/src/app/live/live-client.tsx`.

eli5.text: If you open the live stats page on Freebuff, the screen looks simpler now: the big counter no longer sits under the words "active Freebuff sessions right now," the country list no longer shows the raw two-letter codes like "us" next to the names, and the introductory sentence was shortened from "Real-time Freebuff sessions across every country we can identify, refreshed as people start coding." to just "Real-time Freebuff sessions across every country." The page still updates in real time as people start coding; only the extra text was removed. Nothing else about the page's behavior changed.

ai.title: Add freebuff access tier analytics
ai.summary: Access tier analytics added to completions API. `FreebuffAccessTier` type imported, `trackEvent` enriched with `accessTier` property. Proxy resolution uses `getSystemProcessEnv` in CLI. Covers `cli/src/utils/codebuff-api.ts` and `web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts`.

eli5.text: When you send a message to the assistant through the free service, the system now quietly records whether your account is on the full or limited access tier as part of its routine usage analytics, but it only logs a small sample of these events so that the high volume of free requests doesn't overwhelm the analytics platform. This is live today for free-tier users, and you wouldn't notice it unless you were specifically looking at the behind-the-scenes tracking data. The tracking now includes your access level alongside basic details like whether you're streaming or using a specific agent.

ai.title: Add DeepSeek session trace exporter
ai.summary: New script `scripts/export-deepseek-session-traces.ts` reconstructs multi-turn DeepSeek V4 free-mode sessions from BigQuery. It groups provider call rows by `client_id`, selecting the highest-context request to extract full conversation history. Targets include `base2-free-deepseek` (Pro) and `base2-free-deepseek-flash` (Flash). Supports sampling modes (newest, random, even) and date range filtering for trace export.

eli5.text: Developers added a new internal script that pulls together complete, multi-turn chat conversations from DeepSeek's free tier (both the Pro and Flash versions) into saved trace files. It groups the conversations by a unique session ID and picks the most detailed version of each chat to reconstruct the full back-and-forth history, then writes them out as JSON files or a single combined file. This is a behind-the-scenes tool for the team to inspect and analyze how real free-tier sessions look today, not anything end users would see in the product itself.
